stem: A cold leaf surface approaches the room's dew-point temperature while air RH remains below 100%. What risk becomes more plausible at that leaf surface?
choices: Automatic nutrient precipitation in the root zone
Condensation as the surface reaches conditions where local air can become saturated
Permanent elimination of transpiration throughout the crop
rationale: A surface approaching the dew point can support local saturation and condensation even when bulk-room relative humidity is below 100%.
